purpose: Define MeritCore as the canonical owner of merits, points, Tier, recommendations and trust derived from human-interaction evidence linked to explicit identities and Projects.

topics.name: MeritCore
topics.purpose: Define MeritCore as the canonical owner of merits, points, Tier, recommendations and trust derived from human-interaction evidence linked to explicit identities and Projects.

semantics.backend_rule: Authorized backend/evidence-producing mechanisms write merit evidence; MeritCore calculates points/Tier semantics.
semantics.tier_rule: Tier requires at least 3 qualifying recommendations and 3 qualifying Projects at that Tier, subject to the owning Tier criteria.
semantics.negative_feedback_rule: Negative feedback enters review; applicable higher-Tier peer review may reduce Tier according to explicit policy.
semantics.decay_rule: No generic time decay; recency applies only where competence criteria explicitly require it.
semantics.identity_isolation_rule: Merit histories from separate identities cannot be merged.
semantics.project_rule: Merit evidence links to explicit Project evidence rather than self-authored claims.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio evidence and merit semantics have explicit owners and cannot silently substitute for one another.

hard_gates.condition: PortfolioCore or presentation layer calculates merit/Tier
generic time decay applied without explicit competence criterion
Tier granted without required qualifying evidence
self-authored claim treated as merit evidence without owning evidence semantics

references.purpose: Portfolio may reference evidence but does not own merit calculation.

prose.summary: Define MeritCore as the canonical owner of merits, points, Tier, recommendations and trust derived from human-interaction evidence linked to explicit identities and Projects.
